label: Marx critiqued Smith's division of labor as the institutional root of worker estrangement, deskilling, and alienation
description: Karl Marx formulated a fundamental critique of "Division of Labor", challenging its coherence and proposing an alternative model.
dialecticalTension: Dialectical engagement with the core claims and paradoxes of "Division of Labor".
historicalContext: Inherited and re-evaluated during the 19th Century Divergences.
